works.author: Zajno
works.comment: 网络安全平台 Alcove：平板上大标题“Simple file protection for remote teams”，中央一只荧光绿文件柜，四枚标签点出 Workspace Isolation、Personal Privacy、Centralized Access、Work Data Protection；抽象的安全概念用“一只发光柜子 + 四个卖点标签”一次讲清。
works.comment_en: Alcove cybersecurity platform: a tablet carries the headline "Simple file protection for remote teams" over a glowing green filing cabinet, with four labels — Workspace Isolation, Personal Privacy, Centralized Access, Work Data Protection — turning abstract security into one glowing cabinet and four selling points.
works.title: Cybersecurity Platform Web Design

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: AI 高管仪表盘 Atrium：一句“Good morning, Daniel”开场，Atlas 晨报先讲“今天有三件事等你：两单昨夜成交，Q4 市场预算等你批”，下方 Business health 82、Cash runway 14 个月、日程与待批事项一屏排开；AI 仪表盘用“先给结论、再给数字”让高管 10 秒进入状态。
works.comment_en: Atrium AI executive dashboard opens with "Good morning, Daniel" and an Atlas morning brief — "Three things need you today. Two deals closed overnight, and the Q4 marketing budget is waiting for your approval." — above Business health 82, a 14-month cash runway, schedule and approvals; conclusions first, numbers second, so an exec is up to speed in ten seconds.
works.title: Atrium — Run your day in 10 seconds | AI Executive Dashboard

works.author: Olya Marchak for Dose of Culture
works.comment: 家具电商 App 三屏：粉底上 Flowerpot VP9 Rose 台灯 €500、Egg 3316 扶手椅 €35,000（1949 年设计）各带价格与年份标签，右屏是“Thank you for shopping with us”订单确认；设计师家具电商用“年份 + 价格”把单品讲成值得收藏的物件。
works.comment_en: Furniture e-commerce app in three screens: a pink layout pairs the Flowerpot VP9 Rose lamp (€500) and the Egg 3316 Chair (€35,000, designed 1949), each tagged with price and year, beside a "Thank you for shopping with us" order confirmation — year plus price turns each piece into a collectible.
works.title: Mobile E-Commerce App UI

works.author: Korsa
works.comment: 企业卡落地页 Cardova：笔记本屏上大标题“The card your team will love”，深绿与白色两张卡片叠放，Auto receipt matching、Real-time spend limits 两个卖点贴在卡边；金融科技落地页用“实物卡片 + 两个功能标签”把企业发卡讲得轻松可信。
works.comment_en: Cardova corporate-card landing page: a laptop screen reads "The card your team will love" beside dark-green and white cards, with Auto receipt matching and Real-time spend limits tagged at the edges — physical cards plus two feature labels make corporate cards feel easy and credible.
works.title: Cardova - Fintech Corporate Card Landing Page Animation

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 医疗患者门户 MediConnect：视频问诊主画面是 Dr. Alberto Shulz 与患者 Helena Gayle，右侧 Share health data 面板列出心率 84 bpm、心电图、血常规、血脂四项数据，一键分享；远程医疗用“问诊画面 + 可分享的健康数据卡”把一次复诊做成完整闭环。
works.comment_en: MediConnect patient portal: a video consult with Dr. Alberto Shulz and patient Helena Gayle fills the main frame, while a Share health data panel lists heart rate (84 bpm), ECG, blood count and lipid panel with one Share button — consult plus shareable health cards close the loop on a follow-up visit.
works.title: Medical Website Design - Patient Portal

works.author: Conceptzilla
works.comment: 电动自行车电商 Daily Rider：黑底大图只拍车灯与车架局部，大标题“Daily Rider”，$2,550 划线 $3,000、4.9 分，Configure components 与 Book a test ride 两个按钮并排；高价单品页用“局部特写 + 试骑入口”先勾起欲望、再谈配置。
works.comment_en: Daily Rider e-bike store: a dark close-up of the headlight and frame under the headline "Daily Rider", $2,550 struck against $3,000 with a 4.9 rating, and Configure components beside Book a test ride — a tight crop plus a test-ride entry sells desire before specs.
works.title: E-commerce Website Design

works.author: Kris Anfalova
works.comment: 数字银行 Nova：粉色时尚大片配大标题“Not your parents' bank”，副标“Zero paperwork, zero wait time.”，€3,250.00 转账卡片与“自拍 + 证件，3 分钟开户”并列；年轻化银行用“时尚摄影 + 一句反叛口号”把开户讲成一件酷事。
works.comment_en: Nova digital banking: a pink fashion shoot under the headline "Not your parents' bank" — "Zero paperwork, zero wait time." — with a €3,250.00 transfer card and "Drop a selfie and your ID, and get a fully loaded account in 3 minutes"; fashion photography plus one rebellious slogan makes opening an account feel cool.
works.title: Website Design — Nova Digital Banking

works.author: Fantik Studio®
works.comment: 卫星追踪 3D 仪表盘 Perigee：笔记本屏上是欧洲夜景灯光图，“Port of Rotterdam capture in 00:52”倒计时配 SAR 0.5 m 分辨率标注，左下 Fleet 38/40 机队卡片；硬核航天数据用“地球夜景 + 倒计时”讲成一场值得盯着看的直播。
works.comment_en: Perigee satellite-tracking dashboard: a laptop shows Europe lit up at night, "Port of Rotterdam capture in 00:52" counting down beside a SAR 0.5 m resolution tag and a Fleet 38/40 card — hard aerospace data retold as a live event worth watching.
works.title: satellite tracking 3d dashboard \ perigee®
